description: This file defines an immutable Java class 'CollectionSheetBulkDisbursalCommand' used for representing bulk disbursal commands in a collection sheet context within the Fineract project. It encapsulates details such as a note, a transaction date, and an array of disbursal transactions.

classes.name: CollectionSheetBulkDisbursalCommand
classes.description: Immutable command for handling bulk disbursal operations in collection sheets within the Fineract system.

methods.name: CollectionSheetBulkDisbursalCommand
methods.description: Constructor initializing the disbursal command with note, transaction date, and disbursal transactions array.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Returns the note associated with the bulk disbursal command.

methods.name: getDisburseTransactions
methods.description: Returns the array of disbursal transaction commands.

methods.name: getTransactionDate
methods.description: Returns the date of the transaction.
